segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or oily/combo skin say the moisturizer feels light and does not add greasiness, with a few noting their skin actually seemed less oily with use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it hydrating enough for daily use, though a couple note that dry patches or areas can feel tight after some time and need a second, richer moisturizer layered on.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, non-greasy and good for layering, with one noting it can occasionally sting when their barrier is already compromised.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report no irritation and call it gentle, while others describe burning, redness, or a reaction they consider unusual even though they don't normally have sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 50s with normal-dry, acne-prone mature skin reports that with patience it cleared stubborn closed comedones and left skin smooth and hydrated.

concerns.dehydration: Many say it hydrates well without feeling heavy or greasy; a smaller group finds it insufficiently moisturizing on its own, especially on dry areas, and pairs it with a second moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report burning and visible redness shortly after application, including people who say they don't normally have sensitive skin; most other reviewers report no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the product only stung when their skin barrier was already compromised by other harsh products, suggesting the tingling is context-dependent rather than constant.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report a clear reduction in acne spots, cystic breakouts or scarring within weeks; a minority say it neither improved nor worsened their acne, and one reviewer had breakouts return each time they tried it.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers describing blemishes report fewer breakouts, smoother skin and fading marks after a few weeks; a small number saw no change or say it did not help treat existing acne even though it didn't cause new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oil-prone skin say it left their face less oily than other moisturizers and did not clog pores; no reviewer reports it made oiliness worse.

extraits.titre: I used this until it was gone
extraits.texte: And i had no idea what "pump problem" everyone was talking about but quickly understood towards the end of the bottle. I assume its just the packaging. It works well but unfortunately at the time i was using other products that were ruining my skin barrier and causing this moisturizer to lightly tingle or burn on my face. It was never really a problem unless i had used other abrasive products before. It definitely helps moisturize and is light weight on the skin. I do agree its sticky if you use too much. For reference i have combination skin and occasionally get cystic pimples.
After two or three uses my entire face became red where I had applied it. Cannot figure out which ingredient i would be allergic to. Put Cortizone and neosporin all over my face to calm it down.

extraits.titre: Like the product, hate the packaging
extraits.texte: This moisturizer is a great light moisturizer for acne prone skin. It isn't the most hydrating, I'll notice around my dry areas my skin will feel tight after a little while after applying, so I just use another lotion in combination for those, problem solved. My only complaint is the packaging. Mine stopped being able to pump anymore product when I was barely half way through. I had to cut it open to start using the rest. Having a pump is great, but only when it can actually pump all the product.

extraits.titre: Best for sensitive, acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I've used this for over a year and its a holy grail for acne prone skin. I usually have oily/combo skin and use this moisturizer under Matte Super Goop sunscreen. I haven't had any acne in soo long! I live in a high humidity area and it works great!

extraits.titre: Stick with it, SO Worth it
extraits.texte: Initially, very underwhelmed w/this product. Decided to finish my small sample tube & wow! In my 50's w/normal-dry skin & VERY acne prone. I never get full blown whiteheads nor blackheads just a few congested / closed comedones (always same spot). In almost 3 weeks, no returning comedones plus comfortable hydration & smoooooth skin. Be patient & of you have that stubborn/mild acne on NOT oily skin, this is for you!

Work great on my acne prone skin! Can slightly dry your skin out due to the salicylic acid so I would recommend using this in the morning and using another more hydrating moisturizer at night (or vice versa). Overall love this product if you have acne prone skin!

I love salicylic acid & this is a great moisturizer that has helped keep my skin calm and break out free! Definitely can be a little intense when you first start using it, i had a bit of irritation, but it eventually cleared up after a week or 2 of use. Would not recommend for people with sensitive skin. But for me, this has been a life saver!
